concerns.text: T006a (Validation) depends on T008a (Draft Schema), but T008a is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T006a explicitly requires the draft schema to exist to perform field checks. If T008a runs in parallel with T006a, T006a may fail due to missing file. T008a must precede T006a.

T008b (Generate data-model.md) depends on T008c (Finalize Schema), but T008c depends on T006a. T006a depends on T008a. The chain T008a -> T006a -> T008c -> T008b is correct, but T008b is marked [P]. If T008b runs in parallel with T008c, it will fail to find the finalized schema. T008b must be sequential after T008c.

T014c (Gibberish filtering) depends on T014b (Non-English filtering) and T008c (Schema). T014b is marked [P]. T014c is not marked [P] but depends on T014b's output file. If T014b and T014c run in parallel (as implied by the [P] tag on T014b and lack of explicit blocking on T014c), T014c will fail. T014c must explicitly block T014b completion.

T015 (Model Inference) depends on T014b (Preprocessed Text) and T008c (Schema). T015 is not marked [P], but T014b is. If T014b runs in parallel with T015, T015 will fail. The dependency chain is clear, but the [P] tag on T014b creates a risk of parallel execution with its consumer T015 if the runner ignores the dependency list.

T024a (Verify code logic) depends on T021 and T022. T021 and T022 are marked [P]. T024a is not marked [P]. If T021/T022 run in parallel with T024a, T024a will fail. T024a must be sequential after T021 and T022.

T030 (Skeleton) depends on T017 AND T026. T031 (Merge) depends on T017 AND T026. T032 (Merge and Save) depends on T017 AND T026. T030 is marked [P] but depends on T017/T026. If T030 runs in parallel with T017/T026, it will fail. T030 must be sequential after T017 and T026.
